**Note:** The deadline closes strictly at 17:00:00 Brussels time. This topic implements the co-programmed **European Partnership on AI, data, and robotics (ADRA)**. Each proposal must focus exclusively on one prioritised sector; our consortium's target is **Advanced Manufacturing specifically tailored to Semiconductor Fabrication (Fabs)**.
:::

### 🎁 Expected Outcome by the EU

- 🏭 **Targeted Industrial Breakthroughs:** Drive significant technological progress and innovation in Apply AI prioritised sectors through challenge-oriented, AI-powered solutions.
- 🇪🇺 **SME Ecosystem Development:** Increase the competitiveness and visibility of the European AI developer community within high-stakes application domains, promoting collaborative approaches for industry-specific AI development.
- 📈 **Accelerated AI Adoption:** Deepen the integration of trustworthy AI technologies and AI-powered robotics across crucial nodes of advanced manufacturing supply chains.
